meta.name: Guns & Gulaabs
meta.description:
In the cartel-run town of Gulaabgunj, an unprecedented opium deal pulls a big-city cop and a lovesick mechanic into its chaotic clutches.

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

videos.title: Chapter 1: Har Insaan Mein Hai Shaitaan
videos.overview: After his father’s death, lovelorn mechanic Tipu takes a drastic step. The arrival of cop Arjun Varma causes a stir. A high-stakes deal is afoot.

videos.title: Chapter 2: Everything I Do ... I Do It For You
videos.overview: When his family is threatened, Arjun's faced with a messy problem. Ganchi's gang suffers a sudden blow while the assassin Atmaram takes aim at Tipu.

videos.title: Chapter 3: Kasam Paida Karnewale Ki
videos.overview: A devastated Tipu vows to avenge an emotional loss. Seeking to grab power, a rival cartel makes its move, even as Jugnu steps into his father's shoes.

videos.title: Chapter 4: Deal Ya No Deal
videos.overview: As the two gangs vie for control, Arjun targets opium farms in both regions. Nannu and Jo grow closer, while Tipu and Bunty search for Atmaram.

videos.title: Chapter 5: Do Dil Mil Rahe Hain
videos.overview: A desperate Jugnu throws caution to the wind, while Lekha's family struggles to cope. An attack on the hospital exposes Tipu to Atmaram's wrath.

videos.title: Chapter 6: Pyaar Chutiyapa Hai
videos.overview: Arjun attempts to find his own allies. Nannu's friendship with Jo drives a wedge between he and Gangu. Tipu plots a daring deed to help Lekha.

videos.title: Chapter 7+8: Raat Baaki...
videos.overview: As cops and cartels collide, one truck stands between chaos and control. When Lekha and the kids are pulled into danger, Arjun and Tipu take action.
